# Classification Systems

This folder groups standardized classification systems used to categorize and stratify clinical data within the corpus. It currently contains medical classification frameworks, such as the Montreal classification, which are essential for standardizing epidemiological data and quality indicators across healthcare registries like the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD).

## Pages

- [[entities/classification-systems/medical/index|Medical]] — Standardized medical classification frameworks used to stratify clinical data, currently featuring the Montreal classification for inflammatory bowel disease patients.
